name: Should I try to manage permits and inspections myself, or use support for it?

mainEntity.name: Should I try to manage permits and inspections myself, or use support for it?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you are deciding between doing it yourself and hiring support, the key difference is time and complexity management. Denver’s portal lets owners and contractors manage permits directly, but a coordinator can be helpful when the project has multiple trades, review comments, or a tight schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY can work for simple jobs, but support is usually better for complex or time-sensitive projects. The more trades and inspections involved, the more valuable coordination becomes.
